lines.speaker: Constable Webb
lines.text: Thirty pieces. Is that what a man's conscience goes for nowadays.

lines.speaker: Constable Webb
lines.text: Should've been more. A damn sight more.

lines.speaker: Constable Webb
lines.text: Natural causes. Natural bloody causes. Good lord.

lines.speaker: Constable Webb
lines.text: If that detective keeps sniffing around...

lines.speaker: Constable Webb
lines.text: Just keep your head down, Arthur. Keep your head down.

spotted_message: Webb has seen you. He will be hostile now.
